Remark
[Killing algebras of the model spaces]

Source: petersen:page-0344 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field 1. ch8:8.4.7Let $x^i$ be standard Cartesian coordinates on $\mathbb {R}^n$, and let $W=\mathrm{span}_{\mathbb {R}}\{ 1,x^1,\dots ,x^n\} $, $V=\mathrm{span}_{\mathbb {R}}\{ x^1,\dots ,x^n\} $.

  1. Show that $\iso (\mathbb {R}^n)$ is naturally isomorphic to $\Lambda ^2W$, identifying $u\wedge v$ with the vector field $u abla v-v abla u$.

  2. Show similarly that $\iso (S^{n-1}(R))$ is naturally isomorphic to $\Lambda ^2V$.

  3. Using $ abla u=g^{ij}\partial _iu\, \partial _j$ for a pseudo-Riemannian space, redo (1) for $\mathbb {R}^{p,q}$ and (2) for $H^{n-1}(R)\subset \mathbb {R}^{n,1}$.
